# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝]

I see a bomb display reading 0, a yellow light, and three wires in order: green, yellow, blue. I am reporting all visible details so Mute can match them to the manual and Blind can identify the required physical action. Mute’s handshake gesture has no established meaning yet.

```text
speak(text="Deaf reports: display 0; light yellow; wires in order 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🤝 ☝]

The display remains 0 and the wire colors remain green, yellow, blue. The light has changed from yellow to orange. Mute sent two gestures, handshake followed by pointing upward; I do not yet know what meaning Mute assigns them, so I will report the observed sequence.

```text
speak(text="Update: display still 0; light is now orange; wires still 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Mute gestured handshake then upward point.")
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎]

The light has changed again, now from orange to green, while the display and wire colors remain unchanged. Mute’s latest gesture is thumbs-down; across the rounds, Mute has sent handshake, upward point, then thumbs-down. Since Blind cannot see these gestures, I will relay the complete observed sequence and current bomb state by speech.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Visible state: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Light sequence has been yellow, orange, green. Mute's gestures to Deaf across rounds were handshake, upward point, then thumbs-down.")
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👎]

The visible bomb state is unchanged except the light, which has cycled back to yellow: display 0, wires green/yellow/blue, light sequence yellow → orange → green → yellow. Mute again sent the thumbs-down gesture. I will relay the current state and this repeated signal to Blind.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light is yellow again. Mute again gestured thumbs-down.")
```

LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

(empty)

No new gesture arrived from Mute. I will give both teammates the current state so Mute can apply the manual and Blind can act on the resulting instruction.

```text
speak(text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light orange again. Light sequence so far: yellow, orange, green, yellow, orange. No new gesture from Mute.")
```

Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

The light has cycled to green again; the display remains 0 and the wires remain green, yellow, blue. Mute’s new gesture is an open raised hand (✋). I cannot know its manual-defined meaning, so I will describe it to Blind and report the current state.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light green. Mute gestured an open raised hand, symbol ✋.")
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

The bomb remains at display 0 with wires green, yellow, blue, and the light has cycled back to yellow. Mute repeated ✋, so this is likely deliberate information from the manual, but I do not know its meaning. I will report both the current state and the repeated gesture to Blind, while ensuring Mute has the visual state needed for the manual.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light yellow.")
speak(to="blind", text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light yellow. Mute repeated ✋.")
```

The bomb is unchanged: display 0, wires green/yellow/blue, and the light is yellow. Mute sent 🖐 👋 👍, while Blind sent 🫵. Mute can see both gesture sequences already; Blind needs the Mute sequence and the visible bomb state relayed by voice.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Update: display 0; wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue; light yellow. Mute gestured 🖐 👋 👍.")
speak(to="mute", text="Blind gestured 🫵. Visible bomb state remains display 0, wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 blue, light yellow.")
```
